summary:
Comprehensive architectural and UX plan for Dev0 v1.8:
1. Remove legacy Beta Memory & 5 Identity Files (SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, MEMORY.md) and replace with the Extra YAML Learning & Skill System (recognizing YAML-headed AGENTS.md and skill files, hiding .qoder paths from UI, supporting single file & .zip pack skill uploads, flagging corrupted/non-YAML files with an exclamation badge and 1-click AI Fix button, and configuring Always-On Background vs. Custom Keyword/Phrase triggers).
2. Display a subtle bottom-right active Skill & AGENTS.md badge on chat messages showing which skills/rules the system actually loaded and used for that turn.
3. Enforce Sub-Agent Menu-First Creation in Normal Chat Mode (chatbot cannot directly execute sub-agents; it opens the Sub-Agent configuration modal and creates the sub-agent once defined).
4. Replace duplicate/static thinking boxes with an Animated Reasoning Orb during initial processing that transitions into a single live text-streaming Extended Thinking box, with forced extended thinking in the AI pipeline.
5. Restore the classic Projects view (File Tree & Project Switcher with explicit Delete Project button and fixed persistence) and move the Interactive Synapse Graph (replacing Memos, with Node Drag & Drop, Left-Click Inspector, and Right-Click Context Menu) and Codebase Structure & Node Search into the Tools area, with Dashboard placed in the 1st sub-tab slot ([Dashboard, Tools, Plans, Graph, Search, Chat]) plus an interactive English Tutorial modal.
6. Eliminate all React Native Web 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' errors and make all headers/toolbars responsive across narrow PC windows and Android screens.
